businesses.business: Medical and dental products and healthcare software

offering_description.value: Solventum makes wound care and surgical products for hospitals and home care providers, and restorative and orthodontic products for dental practices. It develops and licenses software for clinical documentation, medical coding and reimbursement, and provides consulting to healthcare organizations.

primary_products.value: Negative-pressure wound therapy systems; wound dressings and surgical infection-prevention supplies; dental restorative materials and adhesives; orthodontic appliances; clinical documentation and medical coding software

primary_services.value: Home wound therapy equipment rental; medical coding and documentation audits; clinical documentation and revenue cycle consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: Hospitals, outpatient clinics, home health agencies, dentists, orthodontists and health insurers; B2G: Public hospitals and government health agencies; B2C: Home wound care patients who receive therapy equipment

end_markets.value: Acute and outpatient care; post-acute and home healthcare; dentistry and orthodontics; health information management; health insurance

revenue_model.value: product sales: Wound care supplies, surgical consumables and dental materials and appliances; rental or leasing: Negative-pressure wound therapy equipment rented for facility or home use; healthcare reimbursement: Insurer payments for covered home wound therapy equipment and supplies; licensing or royalties: Enterprise licenses for medical coding and clinical documentation software; subscription: Hosted clinical documentation and health information software; service fees: Coding audits and clinical documentation and revenue cycle consulting
revenue_model.category: product sales; rental or leasing; healthcare reimbursement; licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns medical-grade materials and components into wound care, surgical and dental products for providers and distributors; software / platform: Processes clinical documentation and coding data for healthcare providers and payers; service provider: Supplies therapy equipment to patients and uses clinical records to advise healthcare organizations
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, Asia-Pacific and Latin America

specialization.value: related lines: Wound care and surgical products, dental and orthodontic supplies, and health information software and services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving hospitals, health systems, dental practices and home care providers; distributors / dealers: Medical-surgical and dental supply distributors

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA and EU medical device requirements, plus HIPAA obligations for handling protected health information
